dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: This is Stone Gate. Keep heading south from here and you'll reach Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: Can I get you a cup of tea?

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: I am the owner of this tea booth. It's not a lucrative business, but you do get to hear a lot of stories.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: Hehehe... Honestly, the thing I love most about running this booth is watching all the travelers come and go, and listening to all the stories they have to tell.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: Look at me, traveler, I'm just an old bag of bones.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: I've never had to weather any great storms in my life, it's been smooth sailing all the way through.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: But when I got old, I started feeling as if I was missing out.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: So I packed a few things and left Mt. Qingce behind...

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: Once I left Qingce Village, I decided that this was where I was going to set up a booth. I don't do anything here except chat to people; listen to their stories, tell them mine... And I'm thoroughly enjoying it!

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: In the end, you only regret the chances you didn't take!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to have some tea, please.

dialogues.speaker: Pops Zhou
dialogues.text: I don't carry any famous teas, but the flavor of what I do have is quite good if I must say so myself. Go ahead, have a sip!
